summary:
I ran every seam case the design built, using the published exe, unelevated, on this PC. All of them held. One defect this slice wrote fails a validate check that Q-027 requires.

**C1 (Stop on both rigs).**
- N-005 on the SMB loopback rig passed. After Stop the panel has exactly a (code 5, 'access denied') and b ('only partly read: network or share error', code 59), each once. s, t and u have no row. The no-Stop control (rig killed 8021 ms after the hold; main run 8025 ms) put s in as code 59 and t and u in as code 53, so the absence is beside a lit control.
- N-006 on the real cldflt sync root passed. a and b are rows. s, t and u have no row under Stop, and also have no row in all three no-Stop controls (release by CfExecute failure, kill, 60.4 s timeout). Each control reported 711 files, 5 folders and 71,100 bytes. This is recorded as the Q-177 platform limit, not a positive check.
- Cleanup held: only the person's own Z: mapping remains, the sync-root count was 1 before and after, and no app, rig or provider process is left.

**C2 (reason of the read that failed).** T-009 passed. The fixture probed 5/32 on h. h's row is NothingListed 32, drawn 'could not be opened: in use by another program', and 'access denied' appears nowhere. c (5/0) is no row. N-005's b row covers the SMB half.

**C4 (Show in Explorer from a panel row).** R-002 passed. Step f (300-character deny-all folder) and step g (1000-character list-denied folder) each landed with the parent's Name, the leaf alone selected by Name, and hr 0, in 389 and 770 ms. There was no #32770 dialog and no consent.exe, and 0 Explorer windows were left.

**C3 (whole C:\).** The C:\ run itself is the person's: a whole-drive scan is theirs to give, and SL-095 measured about 537 MB of pool against the engine's 0.5 GB guard. W-001 ran here on three bounded real roots, all with verdict held:
- WER: 446 rows = header = core.unreadable, 7 drawn; all 446 re-opened and still refused.
- C:\Windows\Logs\ (trailing backslash): 1 row.
- The project's leftover fsa-guard-tests folder: 27 code-363 rows, tallied as expected leftovers, each with a non-empty reason.

**Other checks.**
- WindowMutants -Mutant All killed all 11 mutants (Q-114).
- Fitness: 82 rules hold. rules-parity: AGREE.
- Default suite: 559/562. The 3 failures are the known last-access back-dating tests (Q-190), present before this slice.

**Defect.** The Q-027 rules harness exits 1. SL-089's nine plant rows in eng/rules-harness/plants.json (F36–F40, P28–P31) anchor on `byte[] json = JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(report`. That is only a prefix of WindowReport.cs:276, and the harness needs a whole line. The line has been the same since afd021d, so these rows have never been applied. With the anchor set to the full line, in a copy under artifacts/, all nine come out as recorded in both xUnit and Fitness, and the harness exits 0. So the rule is sound and only the anchor text needs fixing.

**Notes.**
- The menu is still labelled 'Open in Explorer' (a design decision).
- Build attempts 2–4 all answer the same O-034 revoke (attempt 2 was the machine-guard stop). This slice was planned to change no src, so it is not a no-progress loop.

The 9 are exactly SL-089's rows: F36, F37, F38, F39, F40 and P28, P29, P30, P31, each PLANT-BROKEN with "anchor 'byte[] json = JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(report' is not a line of src/FsAnalyser.App/WindowReport.cs". harness.py:358-362 needs the anchor to equal a whole stripped line. criteria.criterion: 1. Stop on the stalled SMB share; s, the folder being listed, is then released by tearing the share down, so its listing ends in a network error
criteria.how: N-005 main: Stop 2 s after the hold, teardown 8025 ms after it; s has no row. Control without Stop (teardown 8021 ms): s is NothingListed 59. Published exe, real Windows SMB client on the loopback rig.

criteria.criterion: 2. Stop on either rig; t and u are first opened after Stop or never, and fail once the share is gone or the provider fails fetches
criteria.how: N-005: the server never opened t or u after Stop and they have no row; the control lit both (53). N-006: t and u have no row under Stop, and no ending lit them without Stop either, so on the cloud rig this is the Q-177 platform limit, not a positive check.

criteria.criterion: 3. Stop on either rig; a (refused at open) and b (failed partway) both finished before Stop
criteria.how: N-005 and N-006 main runs: a (NothingListed 5) and b (ListedPartway 59) are rows once each. Header N = core.unreadable = dump rows = 2. The failpoint fired on b page 3 before Stop in every run.

criteria.criterion: 4. Stop on the hung cloud rig; s's FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS is pending at Stop, then the provider completes it with a failure status
criteria.how: N-006 main: no row for s. The release, kill and timeout controls also gave no row for s and recorded 711 files, 5 folders, 71,100 bytes. Met under Q-177's decided branch (negative result plus all three endings, recorded as a platform limit). The case fails if a later Windows lights kill or timeout.

criteria.criterion: 5. Held folder: keep-last-access open refused (5), plain open gets a sharing violation (32)
criteria.how: T-009: probes h 5/32. Row NothingListed 32 'in use by another program', drawn 'could not be opened: in use by another program'; 'access denied' appears nowhere. HeldFolderReasonTests passes in the default suite.

criteria.criterion: 6. Keep-last-access open refused, nobody holds the folder, so the plain open lists it in full (c)
criteria.how: T-009: c probes 5/0, is listed in full and is no row. core.unreadable is 1.

criteria.criterion: 7. On the SMB rig, b's listing fails on page 3 with Win32 59 after two real pages
criteria.how: N-005: the failpoint fired on b page 3 over SMB. Row ListedPartway 59, drawn 'only partly read: network or share error'. The code is injected client-side, as designed.

criteria.criterion: 8. Whole C:\ scan: the published exe runs non-elevated with several hundred rows, most never realised
criteria.how: Checked on a bounded real root, not the whole drive: W-001 on C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\WER gave 446 rows = header = core.unreadable, 7 realised, no duplicates or empty reasons, elevated false. The whole-C:\ run is planned item 3 (person-run).

criteria.criterion: 9. Whole C:\ scan: a folder whose keep-last-access open was refused and which was then listed in full (~306,000 on this PC)
criteria.how: Checked on bounded real roots: W-001 on C:\Windows\Logs\ (the build measured 12 refused-then-listed folders in its top level) found only 1 row, still refused. On WER all 446 code-5 rows were re-opened and still refused. The checker's refusedThenListed control held. The ~306,000 scale needs the person's C:\ run.

criteria.criterion: 10. Whole C:\ scan: rows left over from the CfProvider rig (code 363 or REPARSE, about 30)
criteria.how: W-001 on the real leftover folder C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Local\Temp\fsa-guard-tests: 27 code-363 rows, tallied as leftoverRows.code363 = 27, reasons non-empty, verdict held. The corpus rows F11/F12/F13 pass in W001OracleTests.

criteria.criterion: 11. Whole C:\ scan: a code-2 row whose folder was deleted during the scan and since recreated
criteria.how: Code contact only: corpus rows F08 and F04 pass in W001OracleTests.TheOracleGivesEveryRowOfTheCorpusItsClass, using real folders. No such row can be produced on demand on a live drive.

criteria.criterion: 12. Show in Explorer from a panel row: denied folder at about 300 characters
criteria.how: R-002 step f: unreadable: surface, Exact, hr 0, landed 389 ms. Folder.Self.Name is the parent's, the single selection's Name is the leaf, 0 #32770 dialogs, 0 consent.exe.

criteria.criterion: 13. Show in Explorer from a panel row: denied folder at about 1000 characters
criteria.how: R-002 step g: Exact, hr 0, landed 770 ms, same Name-only checks, no dialog, no consent.exe. The menu is labelled 'Open in Explorer' (design decision).

criteria.criterion: 14. Show in Explorer from a panel row: the denied folder is hidden or system
criteria.how: The design marks this shape non-material with no test owed; fixtures must not be hidden or system. R-002 asserted the 1000-character folder has neither attribute. Selecting hidden or system items is Q-175's follow-on slice.

planned.evidence: N-005 (SMB loopback) and N-006 (real cldflt root) on the published exe, unelevated. After Stop only a and b are rows, once each. No row for s, nor for t or u, which were never opened after Stop. The SMB controls lit s (59) and t/u (53). The cloud controls lit nothing under release, kill or timeout, recorded as the Q-177 platform limit. Rows come from the hook's dump, cross-checked against the schema-1 header N and core.unreadable, per the design's accepted method.

T-009 on the prepared temp folder: h 5/32 shows 'could not be opened: in use by another program', with no 'access denied'. N-005 on the SMB rig: b shows 'only partly read: network or share error' (ListedPartway 59).

Run unelevated from the repo root, with the wcifs-layer-store precaution on (its default): pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case W-001 -Root C:\ . It must print PASSED: W-001 and write .taad/slices/SL-089/c-drive-run.json showing all of the following. verdict 'held'. scope whole drive. elevated false. rows = header = coreUnreadable, in the hundreds (682 measured in U-108). duplicates 0, emptyReasons 0, notScanned 0. oracle.openRefusedButOpenable 0. leftoverRows code363 or reparse about 30. checkerControls openable, denied and refusedThenListed all true. Same pipeline checked here on WER (446 rows), C:\Windows\Logs\ and fsa-guard-tests (27 code-363 rows), all held.

R-002 steps f (300 characters) and g (1000 characters) invoke the panel row's Explorer action through the hook. Both landed on the parent with the leaf alone selected, checked by Name through Shell.Application, in 389 and 770 ms, hr 0, with no dialog and no consent.exe. 0 Explorer windows left.

obligations.evidence: Measured, and the precondition does NOT hold on this build. In N-006's release control the provider completed s's held FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS (and every later fetch) with STATUS_CLOUD_FILE_UNSUCCESSFUL through CfExecute, 8004 ms after the hold, with no Stop. The scan ended Completed with no row for s (711 files, 5 folders, 71,100 bytes). The obligation names this outcome itself ('If it fails ... open question 2 applies'), and Q-177 decided that branch. N-006 reports it as 'platform gives no failed read (Q-177)'. It cannot become true by rebuilding on this Windows build.

Measured, and the precondition does NOT hold. With no Stop, after the provider began failing fetches (release control) or died (kill) or the filter timed out (60.4 s), t and u had no row in all three controls. N-006 therefore reports their absence after Stop as the Q-177 platform limit, never as a positive check.

N-005 control (no Stop, StallRig killed 8021 ms after the hold) reached an ending and wrote its report and dump. Its rows lit s as NothingListed 59 and t and u as 53, which the main run's 'held' lines cite. The case PASSED with every control check ok.

Release offsets: N-005 control 8021 ms vs main 8025 ms; N-006 release control 8004 ms vs main 8007 ms. Every control and main run logged 'fail-listing armed b page 3 error 59' and 'fail-listing fired b page 3', on fixtures built by the same case code. The case enforces these and passed.

not_reached: The whole-C:\ W-001 run (criterion 3 at full scale: hundreds of rows, ~306,000 refused-then-listed folders): a person runs it, because SL-095 measured ~537 MB of kernel pool for a cold C: scan, past the engine's 0.5 GB guard.
A real remote SMB server or a real network drop: the SMB half used the 127.0.0.1 SMBLibrary rig, and b's code 59 is injected by the client-side listing failpoint.
A real cloud provider (OneDrive): N-006 used tests/CfProvider on a real cldflt root, so the Q-177 platform limit is measured only against that provider's three endings.
Windows 10 (Q-192): every case ran on Windows 11 26200.
Explorer with default Hidden=2 and hidden or system targets from a panel row (out of scope here; Q-175's follow-on slice).
A panel-row reveal on a volume without 8.3 names (D:): R-002 ran on C: only.
